newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bolger spokeswoman says no word from NZ First.
newsitem.headline: Bolger spokeswoman says no word from NZ First.

text.p: A spokeswoman for caretaker Prime Minister Jim Bolger said on Tuesday he had received no word from New Zealand First on the progress of its coalition deliberations.
"Like you, we're waiting," the spokeswoman said.
She said that, contrary to reports, Bolger had not been involved in a meeting with NZ First lawyer Wayne Peters. She said National was represented at the meeting by Justice Minister Doug Graham.

By 6.30 p.m. (0530 GMT), eight hours after it began meeting, the caucus of NZ First MPs had announced no decision on its choice of coalition partner between the caretaker National Party government and centre-left Labour.
